meta.name: prisma-upgrade-v7
meta.description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Prisma 项目从 v6 升到 v7,按清单改完所有破坏性变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目用 Prisma ORM 想升到 v7,却被各种破坏性变更卡住
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade a Prisma project from v6 to v7 by working through every breaking change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project uses Prisma ORM and you're stuck on v7 breaking changes

howto.what: Claude 会按 v6→v7 的破坏性变更清单带你迁移:改 schema 生成器、装驱动适配器、建 prisma.config.ts、改客户端导入等,并排查升级后的报错。
howto.when: 当你提到“升级到 Prisma 7”、“prisma 7 migration”等关键词,或要迁移现有项目、修 v7 报错时接手;MongoDB 项目不适用。

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through the v6→v7 migration by the breaking-change list: generator block, driver adapters, prisma.config.ts, explicit env loading, client imports and entrypoints, plus troubleshooting upgrade errors.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention 'upgrade to prisma 7', 'prisma 7 migration', are migrating an existing project, or fixing v7 errors. Does not apply to MongoDB projects.
